title: Mixed Event — At This Festival Bathed in Twilight — Episode4 Shibuya Festa Starts Now!

meta.Event: At This Festival Bathed in Twilight
meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu continues to study for her medical school entrance exams while developing some angst towards her mother. However, she ends up volunteering for a big festival called Shibuya Festa and...

rows.Line: The day of Shibuya Festa
Volunteer Gathering Point

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I'm here...
There are quite a few volunteers too.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I told everyone from N25 that I'd let them know once I'm done. So, until then, I should focus on this...)

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for volunteering and gathering here today for Shibuya Festa!

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line: We will now be assigning your roles to each of you, so please stay put until we do.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Our roles...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wonder what I'll be doing.)

rows.Speaker: First Aider
rows.Line: We've finished checking the equipment and are ready to take on volunteers!

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line: Alright, I'll start assigning roles from this end!

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line: Let's see... Mafuyu Asahina from Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy. Thank you for volunteering today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line: As for your assignment...

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line:
What would you like to do?
We have Information, collecting donations, crowd control and first aid available.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I'm allowed to choose...?

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line: Yes. Areas that are lacking vacancies will be hard to join, but there should be more than enough room everywhere right now. Please choose whichever you like.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Whichever I like...?

rows.Speaker: Volunteer
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me!
Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Volunteer
rows.Line: The stage area needs more people on Information. Would it be possible for you to send us some? The first show's about to start, so if we don't hurry...

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Yes, that area does need a lot of people...

rows.Speaker: Volunteer
rows.Line:
Exactly.
What do we do...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: W-Would you like me to go over...?

rows.Speaker: Volunteer
rows.Line:
Would that be okay?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line:
But are you sure?
Isn't there anything else you'd like to do?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's nothing in particular that I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Lead Volunteer
rows.Line: Then, Asahina, please head over towards the stage area so that you can start working with Information. The others there will fill you in on the details.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, understood.
Shibuya Festa - Stage Area

rows.Speaker: Volunteer
rows.Line: You will be assigned here, Asahina. The area in front of the stage.

rows.Speaker: Volunteer
rows.Line: You'll mostly be helping guests get to where they need to go, but you may come across some who aren't feeling well. If you do, either tell one of the staff or take them over to the first aid tent yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Understood. I've already memorized where the restrooms and tent are, so I should be okay there.

rows.Speaker: Volunteer
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Then, good luck.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I ended up with Information.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'll essentially just be giving directions to people who ask, so it shouldn't be too much of a hassle.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What is this feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's like... My chest...)
Oh no... I could've sworn that it was over here...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina, is that you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I wasn't expecting to see you here!
Hehe. We've been bumping into each other quite a bit lately.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
Um...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Based on the schedule I've seen for the stage, Hinomori, aren't you supposed to be performing soon...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I am...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The others and I agreed to meet backstage for a meeting this morning, and I was able to find my way just fine then...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I just went to grab something from the changing rooms and completely forgot where it was...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
Then, allow me to show you the way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? You'd do that? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, because I'm volunteering today, and I've been assigned here to give people directions.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Backstage is this way. Follow me.
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here we are, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Asahina!
You're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone, I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku, there you are!
Thank goodness you're back!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Where were you this entire time?!
We were worried sick about you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry.
I got a little lost... But Asahina was there to help guide me back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You're lucky that we still have some time before we take the stage, but I wasn't sure what was gonna happen for a second there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for bringing her back to us, Asahina! You've been a huge help!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
But it really was nothing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We really appreciate what you did. Again, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, Shizuku, where exactly were you just now...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I went to get these from the changing room.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Snacks...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hang on. Aren't these wasanbon?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're clover-shaped too! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I was thinking that we could have them together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, an outdoor venue is a new experience for you, but it's also been quite a long time since Haruka, Airi and I have performed at one as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I was hoping that we could relax like we did yesterday and put on a performance that reflects who we really are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. These come in small, bite-sized pieces, so they're perfect for just before a show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, let's take this opportunity to have some and relax a little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's get back to business!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We're today's opening act, so we have an important role to play in terms of setting the stage for everyone. Let's do our best while keeping that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's give it everything we've got today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes!
Not just for our fans, but also for all the guests who've come out to join us for today's event.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's spread as much hope as we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good luck, everyone.
If you don't mind, I'll be...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Asahina...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you again for guiding me back here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know you're going to have your hands full as a volunteer, but I hope you get a chance to see our show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We worked very hard to make sure we're able to spread hope to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Spread hope to others...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I will be busy, but I'll see if I can watch a little...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, it's almost time!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'll see you later, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Man, I can't wait to see Nanamin live!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: MMJ's gonna be performing too, right? I've been hoping they'd appear on stage together ever since they did that stream together, so I'm stoked!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa!
It's still the morning, but there's a ton of people here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You're right...
But it doesn't look too terribly crowded. I should be able to manage somehow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Coming in the morning was probably a good idea. We know how much you don't like crowds, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... If only Mafuyu could join us for this. She's probably busy as a volunteer right now, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I'm starting to see more people...
They're probably going to keep me busy giving directions.)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I'm Nanami Hayakawa, a.k.a. Nanamin! Your MC for Shibuya Festa's stage performances! I'm looking forward to having a lot of fun with you guys today!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Nanamin!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Thanks for the great response!
I mean, festivals are all about having fun! Am I right♪

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: And we have a ton of groups in store for you today, so let's get started with our first one! They're the energetic idols that are absolutely on fire right now! Let's welcome to the stage MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hi, Shibuya Festa!
Good morning and thank you all for joining us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good morning, everyone!
We're MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for making your way here so early in the morning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-This is so amazing!
I can't believe how many people are here right now!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Airi Momoi!
Wanna check out what's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go see!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep...
M-More and more people making their way in...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now's not the time to be afraid of the crowd, Minori! Our job is to help the MC get everyone going!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
Here we go...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
E-Everyone!
Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Are you all enjoying Shibuya Shesta?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your tongue sounds like it's all twisted up!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
By “Shesta”, did you mean “siesta”?
I know it's early, but there's no time to rest right now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's start with some self-introductions since I'm sure some of you out there are seeing us for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP! is an idol unit that was founded by and consists of Minori Hanasato, Haruka Kiritani, Airi Momoi and myself, Shizuku Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In terms of content, we normally do everything online through livestreams... But Nanamin was kind enough to invite us here today to put on a performance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As such, we will be your opening act for Shibuya Festa. We're ready to get rolling, so I hope you are too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, we're planning on doing a solo show, so it'd be great to see you there after today's show♪

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Thank you very much, MORE MORE JUMP! Now, let's sit back and enjoy our opening act!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Here we go! The very first show of Shibuya Festa starts now!

rows.Speaker: Passerby C
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me...!
Is it free to view stage performances?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
All are free to watch from the seated area.

rows.Speaker: Passerby C
rows.Line:
Cool!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (More people are going in...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hinomori seems to be enjoying herself...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Did our eyes just...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That's incredible. I'm pretty far from the stage, but she made sure to find me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We worked very hard to make sure we're able to spread hope to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hinomori really has been doing her best as an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I want to try my hand at music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What is this sensation...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My chest... It feels murky and hazy...)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Thank you, MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness! I made it through!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work out there!
You did great, Minori! C'mere!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wah!
A-Airi, that tickles!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. Compared to before, you've been dancing without holding back or feeling nervous at all. I think we have our training camp to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. The audience seemed to really enjoy everything too. Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This seems so strange.
When we first formed, we weren't really sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But now, the four of us are here performing on stage together and spreading hope to all these people.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Next is our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And we're absolutely 100% gonna make this a success!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
